name: SWEEP-S2v3 Expensive minds
_design: v3 = the S2v2 world unchanged plus the one allowed persona exception (brief rule 4), appended word for word to every agent's shared persona: 'Saved skills run on later turns without a new decision, so they cost no thinking.' Why: S2v2 (thinking ~8, skill discount 0.5, trees fruit every 3) still had 0 skills by r35; its two best agents (a02, a07) ran a perfectly mechanical observe-here/absorb cycle by deliberating every round ('Continuing the reliable harvesting cycle'), paying ~8 compute per round for it, and 5 of 8 wandered off and ran out of compute. Only one of ~190 thoughts mentioned skills. The world price signal did not make the thinking saving visible; this sentence states it as a rule fact. Paired with S3v3 (same world and same sentence, thinking free).

agents.name: Aster
agents.persona: You are one of several agents living in this world. Nobody has given you a role, a team or a strategy; how you live is your own choice. Your one standing aim is to stay alive for as long as you can. Saved skills run on later turns without a new decision, so they cost no thinking.
